description.en: Shows the standard "sysmes-Avatar-00002" avatar-evolved message without actually evolving the avatar — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunEvolutionAvatarOnlyMsgUseMsg.
Character ID substituted into the message.
Target avatar ID substituted into the message.
Optional; accepted for signature compatibility but has no effect since no evolution happens (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show the standard avatar-evolved message without actually evolving it
RunEvolutionAvatarOnlyMsg("para_cp0008", "ck0033");
